biological_interpretation: Posterior and selected inhibitory neurons are selectively sensitive to partial spliceosome/TREX disruption and shift into RNA-processing abundance states rather than showing uniform housekeeping collapse.
caveats: Thoc2 had no FDR-level target-transcript depletion and only one FDR-resolved responder class.
Several neighbor claims for Ascc3, Snrnp70, Tardbp and Srrm2 are correlation evidence and are weaker than the Cdc40/Rnpc3/Thoc1 differential-expression programs.
exact_observed_result: Cdc40, Rnpc3, Thoc1 and Thoc2 each produced cell-gated RNA-processing responses: Cdc40 lowered Srrm2, Rsrp1, Srsf6 and Pabpn1 while increasing Pde4a in posterior neurons; Rnpc3 induced Pcyt2/Mapk8/Ap2a1/Rab6b/Smyd2/Srp72/Trit1 with Amy1/Tcea2 down in 151 TH; Thoc1 repressed Snhg11/Rsrp1/Fam193b and induced Smarcc2/Anxa6/Dgkz/Gtf2i in subcortical classes; Thoc2 was FDR-resolved only in 052 Pvalb. Snrnp70, Ascc3, Tardbp and Srrm2 supplied weaker convergence/non-interchangeability evidence tying these states to spliceosome, RNA-export and proteasome neighbors.

prior_expectation.summary: Prior work supports the broad molecular function of the perturbed target or complex, while the atlas result refines the affected brain cell type and RNA-output module.

resolved_evidence.description: Direct ASCC/ALKBH/RQT complex-member contrasts were unavailable, so related-target analysis had to rely on measured transcripts and signature neighbors.
resolved_evidence.statistics: The library contained 2046 distinct gene_target values overall; Ascc3 was present, but Ascc1, Ascc2, Trip4, Alkbh3, and Zfp598 were absent as perturbation targets.

resolved_evidence.description: Cdc40 output genes were recapitulated by several spliceosome-related perturbations, especially Prpf6, Ddx23, and U2af2.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Pearson correlations restricted to the Cdc40 FDR<0.05 genes: in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Cdc40 correlated with Prpf6 r=0.705, Ddx23 r=0.629, U2af2 r=0.613, Snrnp70 r=0.522, Tpr r=0.702, Srrm2 r=0.370, and Ddx39b r=0.176 across 624 genes. In 155 MB Glut, r values across 431 genes were Prpf6 0.727, Ddx23 0.658, U2af2 0.702, Snrnp70 0.514, Tpr 0.733, Srrm2 0.353, and Ddx39b 0.317.

resolved_evidence.description: No perturbation produced a strong genome-wide inverse of the Cdc40 signature; the top neighbors were spliceosome or nuclear transport-associated perturbations.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Genome-wide score-vector neighbors were positively biased and weakly anti-correlated in the main classes. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, the top Cdc40 neighbors were Tpr r=0.369, Prpf6 r=0.367, Ddx23 r=0.302, U2af2 r=0.297, and the most negative correlation was r=-0.079. In 155 MB Glut, top neighbors were Prpf6 r=0.384, Tpr r=0.357, U2af2 r=0.350, Ddx23 r=0.342, and the most negative correlation was r=-0.092.

resolved_evidence.description: The closest published PRP17 disease partner, Ppil1, could not be directly compared as a perturbation in this dataset.
resolved_evidence.statistics: The parquet contained 2046 unique gene_target values. Ppil1 was not among them; Prpf6, Ddx23, U2af2, Snrnp70, Srrm2, and Ddx39b were available for comparison.

resolved_evidence.description: Other RNA-processing and proteasome perturbations were positive restricted-signature neighbors of Snrnp70 in the main responder cell types.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Pearson correlations on each cell type's Snrnp70 FDR<0.05 genes. 155 MB Glut, n=386 genes: Prpf6 r=0.709, Psmc1 0.673, Psmc5 0.658, Psmb4 0.633, Thoc1 0.583, U2af2 0.550. 151 TH, n=213: Psmc5 0.654, Psmc1 0.627, Psmb4 0.626, U2af2 0.620, Prpf6 0.609. 191 MB P MY GABA, n=102: Ddx39b 0.675, Psmc1 0.672, Psmc5 0.625, Thoc1 0.603, Pomp 0.589, Prpf6 0.548.

resolved_evidence.description: Assayed Sm-family perturbations were nearly silent in the cell types where Snrnp70 produced large signatures.
resolved_evidence.statistics: FDR<0.05 gene counts in 007/110/151/155/191 were Snrnp70: 90/98/213/386/102; Snrpb: 1/0/0/0/0; Snrpn: 1/1/1/1/1. Snrpb self-transcript was FDR=1 in all five; Snrpn self-transcript logFC ranged -0.375 to -0.688 and was FDR-significant in the four 110/151/155/191 strong contexts.

resolved_evidence.description: Restricted signature-neighbor analysis connected Tardbp-sensitive groups to perturbations of spliceosome and splicing-regulatory genes.
resolved_evidence.statistics: All-gene Pearson correlations to the Tardbp score vector in high-signal hindbrain/thalamic groups included 151: Prpf6 r=0.148, Ddx23 r=0.125, Srsf1 r=0.125, U2af2 r=0.120; 155: Prpf6 r=0.134, Ddx23 r=0.111, Snrnp70 r=0.079; 191: Prpf6 r=0.122, Srsf1 r=0.112, Snrnp70 r=0.075. On the top 200 absolute Tardbp genes, 151 U2af2 r=0.371, 155 Snrnp70 r=0.369, and 191 Srsf1 r=0.327/Snrnp70 r=0.306.

resolved_evidence.description: Closest positive neighbors were spliceosome/RNA-processing genes, with modest absolute correlations.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Srrm2 top positive related neighbors in 151/155/191 were Snrnp70 r=0.186/0.208/0.194, U2af2 r=0.158/0.173/0.177, Prpf6 r=0.161/0.139/0.156, and Thoc1 r=0.127/0.153/0.151. Top negative correlations in these groups had |r|<=0.068.

resolved_evidence.description: A very strong Srsf1 perturbation did not phenocopy Srrm2.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Srsf1 perturbation in 151/155/191 had target FDR 7.05e-65/3.01e-42/2.05e-29 and 2764/1455/1117 FDR<0.05 off-target genes. Srrm2-versus-Srsf1 correlations were r=0.0178/0.0228/-0.00625.

title: Partial loss of spliceosome and TREX factors drives posterior RNA-processing stress programs
